The knowledge base supports the requirement-to-measurement chain, but it does not directly prove that the Aerospace & Defense resilience test used CMX500, because the source only mentions CMX customers and a 5G test setup, not a hardware model, option, or configuration [33].
| Chain step | Supported mapping |
|---|---|
| Aerospace / Defense market requirement | The A&D context is a presentation titled “Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient” by Randy Schnell, Business Development Manager, Aerospace & Defense Test [34][35]. |
| Market problem | The mission background is rising tactical-edge demand for data and low latency, increasing smart-jamming / EW threats, and growing private 5G adoption in military bases and tactical environments [35]. |
| DUT constraint | The problem is whether an unmodified 5G DUT connection can be made more resilient using legacy frequency-hopping / FHSS capability [35]. |
| Signaling measurement parameter | The test design maps the problem to 5G handover signaling, frequency-hopping signaling, UE capability messages for supported bands, and handover interruption intervals from 3GPP TS 38.300 [35]. |
| Service / application measurement parameter | The reported outcome uses throughput and WebRTC statistics to support video-call reliability, but the source does not provide numeric throughput, jitter, packet loss, bandwidth, jammer profile, or modem details [35][37]. |
| Additional measurable parameters | The related handover-frequency-hopping whitepaper measures handover interruption, RTT, iPerf, and WebRTC QoS [42]. |
| Signaling tester capability facts | The R&S CMX500 provides NR FR1 / FR2 signaling, LTE signaling, fading, BLER, CSI report, throughput measurement, PER measurement, application test, IP traffic analysis, IMS / audio / POLQA, GUI, XLAPI, and SCPI remote control [18]. |
| Mobility / handover automation facts | The R&S CMX-KF604X package covers cell selection / reselection, 5GC mobility, measurement reporting, mobility with EUTRAN, handover recovery, BWP switching, and LADN [63]. |
| Non-signaling / RF capability facts | The R&S CMX500 supports FR1 / FR2 RF parametric testing and fading propagation conditions [20]. |
| Non-signaling / TX measurement facts | The R&S CMX500 provides NR FR1 / FR2 TX measurements, LTE measurements, WLAN TX measurements, BLER, throughput measurement, and PER measurement [18]. |
| RF generator capability facts | The R&S CMX500 RF generator frequency range is 400 MHz to 8000 MHz, with 0.1 Hz frequency resolution, 1000 MHz non-contiguous instantaneous bandwidth, and 250 MHz RF bandwidth [23]. |
| Evidence gap | The smart-jamming sources do not provide jammer profile, jammer power, distance, frequency bands, dwell time, attack timeline, or whether the test used a physical jammer, emulation, channel emulator, or network-side impairment injection [44]. |
【推論】For the signaling-tester branch, the chain is: A&D private-5G resilience requirement → handover interruption, UE-supported bands, throughput, RTT, iPerf, and WebRTC QoS → NR / LTE signaling, network-emulation, mobility / handover automation, IP traffic analysis, throughput measurement, and remote automation capability [18][35][42][46][63].
【推論】For the non-signaling / RF branch, the chain is: contested-RF reliability requirement → RF / TX and link-quality parameters such as BLER, PER, throughput, and RF parametric behavior → RF parametric testing, TX measurements, fading, BLER / PER / throughput measurements, and 400 MHz to 8000 MHz RF generation capability [18][20][23][35].

3GPP NTN Signal Generator Solutions Overview-EN-UR › 3GPP NTN system architectures
來源 slide 5 依 [[3GPP TR 38.821]] 列出三種 [[3GPP NTN]] system architectures：

- transparent payload。
- regenerative – gNB processed。
- regenerative – gNB-DU processed。

來源文字補充：gNB functionality 可 split into CU（central unit）與 DU（distributed unit）；feeder link / SRI between NTN gateway and satellite would transport F1 protocol。若 RRC 與 Layer 3 processing terminate in gNB-CU on ground，timing impacts follow，且 GEO worse than LEO。ISL（Inter-Satellite Links）是 satellites between transport link，可為 radio interface 或 optical interface，可能是 3GPP 或 non-3GPP defined，但 out of study item scope。

2025-12-19 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient › 重點摘要
這份來源是由 [[Randy Schnell]] 製作 / 主講的 company restricted 簡報，題為 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient；raw frontmatter 顯示原檔為 `2025-12-19 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient.pptx`，轉檔日期為 2026-09-17。來源正文沒有另外標示正式發布日期；本頁以檔名 / raw title 的 2025-12-19 作為來源日期線索。

簡報主張的核心問題是：在不修改 [[DUT]] 的前提下，能否利用 legacy [[Frequency hopping for 5G resilience]] / [[FHSS]] 能力，讓 unmodified 5G DUT connection 對 [[Smart Jamming]] 更具韌性。

主要內容如下：

- 任務背景：tactical edge connectivity 對資料與低延遲需求提高，[[Smart Jamming]] 與 electronic warfare（[[EW]]）威脅增加，private [[5G]] networks 在 military bases / tactical environments 的採用升高。
- 技術映射：來源將問題映射到 5G handover（[[HO]]）signaling 與 frequency-hopping（[[FH]]）signaling；測試設計需使用 [[UE]] capabilities message 回報的 supported bands，並關注 [[3GPP TS 38.300]] 定義的 handover interruption intervals。
- 測試結果：來源聲稱 both modems showed sufficient performance for running video call；throughput 與 [[WebRTC]] statistics 支撐 video-call reliability 維持，但投影片 OCR 未提供具體 throughput、jitter、packet loss、bandwidth、jammer profile 或 modem 型號數值。
- 現有 defense / Future-G program 脈絡：來源列出 [[5G.MIL]]、[[Raytheon OXYGEN]]、[[L3Harris Tactical Network Demo]]、[[DoD EMS Superiority Strategy]]、[[FutureG ISAC]] / spectrum sharing 等項目，說明 FHSS / frequency-agile operation 與 5G / 6G coexistence 的整合方向。
- 時程展望：來源給出 short term 2025–2028、mid term 2028–2032、long term 2032–2035+ 三段式展望，包含 5G tactical networks scale-out、mmWave phased arrays field testing、5G/6G-capable SD radios、early ISAC for drone detection / perimeter defense、URLLC for autonomy、full 6G with integrated sensing、AI-native battlefield connectivity 與 spectrum-aware autonomy。
- Call to action：重新接觸既有 CMX customers，尤其 DOW customers；與 integrators 溝通；保持 tactical patience；提早 engage BDM organization；跨團隊分享 lessons learned。

passages.text:
Smart Jamming
[[Smart Jamming]] 是 mission-critical / military wireless communications 中的 adaptive RF jamming threat；目前來源把它描述為能追蹤通訊頻率、在特定時刻發射 noise、造成 service disruption 且 difficult to detect 的攻擊方式。

Smart Jamming › 來源中的定義與語境
依 [[2025-12-19 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient]]（檔名 / raw title 含 2025-12-19；raw converted 2026-09-17）：

- mission context 包含 rise of smart jamming and improved [[EW]] tactics。
- problem statement 指向 current vulnerability of 5G [[DUT]] connections under smart-jamming。
- source problem question 是：是否能在不修改 [[DUT]] 的前提下，使用 legacy [[Frequency hopping for 5G resilience]] / [[FHSS]] capabilities 強化連線。
- outcome 語境稱，在 smart-jammer pressure 下，both modems showed sufficient performance for running video call；但簡報沒有完整數值。

[[5G-hardening-against-smart-jammer-attacks_wp_en_3610-1591-52_v0100]]（Version 01.00，August 2025）提供更具體描述：newer, cheaper and more powerful [[RF]] equipment for consumer use, like [[SDR]] devices, can easily be converted into smart jammers；這些 devices can track the used frequency of the communications and transmit noise at specific moments to disrupt the communications while being difficult to track。

Smart Jamming › 與一般 jamming 的區分限制
目前來源可以支持以下敘述：

- smart jamming 與 [[SDR]] accessibility 相關；來源把 cheaper / more powerful consumer RF equipment 視為 threat enabler。
- smart jammer 被描述為會追蹤 used frequency，而非只做固定頻率或寬頻干擾。
- smart jammer 在 specific moments 發射 noise，因此其 detection / tracking 較困難。

但來源仍沒有提供正式 taxonomy，不能區分其是否屬於 broadband noise jammer、spot jammer、swept jammer、protocol-aware jammer、reactive jammer 或 AI-assisted jammer。

Smart Jamming › 對 5G private networks 的影響
[[2025-12-19 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient]] 中的 operator expectation mismatch 是：operators expect commercial-grade throughput under adversarial conditions。也就是 private 5G / tactical edge 期待維持 throughput 與 video-call reliability，但 smart jamming / [[EW]] 使連線服務連續性變成問題。

[[5G-hardening-against-smart-jammer-attacks_wp_en_3610-1591-52_v0100]] 則把影響放在 mission-critical use cases：emergencies、disasters、military operations、essential public services 與 potentially NATO / DoD public-private 5G networks。來源強調 reliability is of upmost importance and should not be compromised in such an accessible way。

Smart Jamming › Mitigation direction
兩份來源的主要 mitigation direction 都是 [[Frequency hopping for 5G resilience]]。白皮書將其具體化為 [[Handover frequency hopping]]：

- 使用 [[5G Handover]] 在 n41、n78、n79 等不同 carrier frequency / cell 間切換；
- 讓 jammer 必須 constantly listen and readjust to every change；
- 若 procedure completed at a high frequency rate，jammer would not be able to keep up；
- dynamic target-cell activation 可隱藏 next hop information。

使用限制：白皮書沒有實體 jammer 對抗實驗細節，主要量測 handover interruption、RTT、iPerf 與 [[WebRTC]] QoS。

Smart Jamming › 與既有頁面的關係
- [[5G private network resilience against smart jamming]] 是本概念在 private 5G / tactical network 場景下的主頁。
- [[Handover frequency hopping]] 是目前來源中最具體的 mitigation implementation。
- [[Counter-UAV 技術]] 中的 [[RF Jammers]]、[[GPS Spoofers]] 與 detection / neutralization 技術同樣屬 contested RF / countermeasure 脈絡，但 [[Counter UAV tech]] 未描述 5G smart jamming。
- [[UAV 通訊]] 與 [[UAV 通訊頻段]] 涉及 UAV C2 / telemetry / payload links；不可由 UAV 頻段表推論 smart jammer 的 5G 攻擊頻段。

Smart Jamming › unresolved
- 來源未定義 smart jammer 的完整技術分類、訊號特徵或 detection criteria。
- 來源未提供 jammer profile、jammer power、距離、頻段、掃頻 / 跳頻策略、dwell time 或 attack timeline。
- 來源未說明 smart-jamming test 是否使用實體 jammer、emulation、channel emulator 或 network-side impairment injection。
- [[5G-hardening-against-smart-jammer-attacks_wp_en_3610-1591-52_v0100]] 的實驗並未提供 jammer reacquisition time 或 jamming success probability，因此不能量化 anti-jam security gain。

Frequency hopping for 5G resilience › 使用限制
- 不可把本來源解讀為 3GPP 已標準化某種 5G FHSS anti-jam waveform。
- 不可由 legacy FH capabilities 推論具體 tactical radio、SINCGARS / SRW 實作或 [[R&S CMX500]] option。
- 不可把 video-call outcome 當作所有 smart-jamming 情境的保證；簡報本身說 this does not mean invulnerability。
- [[5G-hardening-against-smart-jammer-attacks_wp_en_3610-1591-52_v0100]] 是 Market white paper，不是 binding product specifications；頁尾寫明 data without tolerance limits is not binding。

Frequency hopping for 5G resilience › 與 5G handover 的映射
[[2025-12-19 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient]] 把方法映射到：

- [[5G Handover]] signaling procedure；
- 5G frequency-hopping / frequency agility behavior；
- UE-reported band support；
- [[HO interruption interval]]，並標註 message definitions / intervals per [[3GPP TS 38.300]]。

[[5G-hardening-against-smart-jammer-attacks_wp_en_3610-1591-52_v0100]] 進一步說明：5G operates on a fixed frequency for each cell；雖然已有 limited form of frequency hopping，但它 confined to the cell bandwidth and resource block allocation。白皮書提出利用 inter-frequency handover 在不同 cells / carriers 間切換，讓 5G 表現得像 frequency hopping。

Frequency hopping for 5G resilience › 與 FHSS 的關係
兩份來源都使用 legacy FH capabilities、frequency-hopping、FHSS、frequency-agile operation 等語彙。本頁不把它們裁決為同一技術實作：

- [[FHSS]] 在簡報中主要出現在 defense program table。
- [[5G-hardening-against-smart-jammer-attacks_wp_en_3610-1591-52_v0100]] 的實作是 handover-based inter-frequency carrier switching。
- 白皮書沒有提供 hop sequence、spreading code、synchronization、dwell time、jammer reacquisition time 或 PHY-layer FH waveform details。

Frequency hopping for 5G resilience › Defense program context
[[2025-12-19 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient]] 列出多個 FHSS / 5G integration examples：

| Program / effort | 來源中的 FHSS role | 來源中的 5G integration |
|---|---|---|
| [[5G.MIL]] | LPX LPI/LPD waveform，FH-type | Hybrid 5G + tactical waveform switching |
| [[Raytheon OXYGEN]] | Tactical MANET needing FHSS anti-jam | 5G sidelink extended to tactical radios |
| [[L3Harris Tactical Network Demo]] | FHSS tactical radios such as SINCGARS / HQ / SRW | SDRs + 5G gateways integration |
| [[DoD EMS Superiority Strategy]] | FH agile operation for contested EW | 5G included in EMS-aware backbone |
| [[FutureG ISAC]] / spectrum sharing | Freq-agile operation for shared spectrum | 5G / 6G coexistence in contested bands |

使用限制：來源未提供 program official documents、dates、contracts、technical architectures 或 measured performance；此表是簡報中的 program mapping，不可視為完整市場證據。

The knowledge base supports the requirement-to-measurement chain, but it does not directly prove that the Aerospace & Defense resilience test used CMX500, because the source only mentions CMX customers and a 5G test setup, not a hardware model, option, or configuration [33].
| Chain step | Supported mapping |
|---|---|
| Aerospace / Defense market requirement | The A&D context is a presentation titled “Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient” by Randy Schnell, Business Development Manager, Aerospace & Defense Test [34][35]. |
| Market problem | The mission background is rising tactical-edge demand for data and low latency, increasing smart-jamming / EW threats, and growing private 5G adoption in military bases and tactical environments [35]. |
| DUT constraint | The problem is whether an unmodified 5G DUT connection can be made more resilient using legacy frequency-hopping / FHSS capability [35]. |
| Signaling measurement parameter | The test design maps the problem to 5G handover signaling, frequency-hopping signaling, UE capability messages for supported bands, and handover interruption intervals from 3GPP TS 38.300 [35]. |
| Service / application measurement parameter | The reported outcome uses throughput and WebRTC statistics to support video-call reliability, but the source does not provide numeric throughput, jitter, packet loss, bandwidth, jammer profile, or modem details [35][37]. |
| Additional measurable parameters | The related handover-frequency-hopping whitepaper measures handover interruption, RTT, iPerf, and WebRTC QoS [42]. |
| Signaling tester capability facts | The R&S CMX500 provides NR FR1 / FR2 signaling, LTE signaling, fading, BLER, CSI report, throughput measurement, PER measurement, application test, IP traffic analysis, IMS / audio / POLQA, GUI, XLAPI, and SCPI remote control [18]. |
| Mobility / handover automation facts | The R&S CMX-KF604X package covers cell selection / reselection, 5GC mobility, measurement reporting, mobility with EUTRAN, handover recovery, BWP switching, and LADN [63]. |
| Non-signaling / RF capability facts | The R&S CMX500 supports FR1 / FR2 RF parametric testing and fading propagation conditions [20]. |
| Non-signaling / TX measurement facts | The R&S CMX500 provides NR FR1 / FR2 TX measurements, LTE measurements, WLAN TX measurements, BLER, throughput measurement, and PER measurement [18]. |
| RF generator capability facts | The R&S CMX500 RF generator frequency range is 400 MHz to 8000 MHz, with 0.1 Hz frequency resolution, 1000 MHz non-contiguous instantaneous bandwidth, and 250 MHz RF bandwidth [23]. |
| Evidence gap | The smart-jamming sources do not provide jammer profile, jammer power, distance, frequency bands, dwell time, attack timeline, or whether the test used a physical jammer, emulation, channel emulator, or network-side impairment injection [44]. |
【推論】For the signaling-tester branch, the chain is: A&D private-5G resilience requirement → handover interruption, UE-supported bands, throughput, RTT, iPerf, and WebRTC QoS → NR / LTE signaling, network-emulation, mobility / handover automation, IP traffic analysis, throughput measurement, and remote automation capability [18][35][42][46][63].
【推論】For the non-signaling / RF branch, the chain is: contested-RF reliability requirement → RF / TX and link-quality parameters such as BLER, PER, throughput, and RF parametric behavior → RF parametric testing, TX measurements, fading, BLER / PER / throughput measurements, and 400 MHz to 8000 MHz RF generation capability [18][20][23][35].

2025-12-19 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient › 重點摘要
這份來源是由 [[Randy Schnell]] 製作 / 主講的 company restricted 簡報，題為 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient；raw frontmatter 顯示原檔為 `2025-12-19 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient.pptx`，轉檔日期為 2026-09-17。來源正文沒有另外標示正式發布日期；本頁以檔名 / raw title 的 2025-12-19 作為來源日期線索。

簡報主張的核心問題是：在不修改 [[DUT]] 的前提下，能否利用 legacy [[Frequency hopping for 5G resilience]] / [[FHSS]] 能力，讓 unmodified 5G DUT connection 對 [[Smart Jamming]] 更具韌性。

主要內容如下：

- 任務背景：tactical edge connectivity 對資料與低延遲需求提高，[[Smart Jamming]] 與 electronic warfare（[[EW]]）威脅增加，private [[5G]] networks 在 military bases / tactical environments 的採用升高。
- 技術映射：來源將問題映射到 5G handover（[[HO]]）signaling 與 frequency-hopping（[[FH]]）signaling；測試設計需使用 [[UE]] capabilities message 回報的 supported bands，並關注 [[3GPP TS 38.300]] 定義的 handover interruption intervals。
- 測試結果：來源聲稱 both modems showed sufficient performance for running video call；throughput 與 [[WebRTC]] statistics 支撐 video-call reliability 維持，但投影片 OCR 未提供具體 throughput、jitter、packet loss、bandwidth、jammer profile 或 modem 型號數值。
- 現有 defense / Future-G program 脈絡：來源列出 [[5G.MIL]]、[[Raytheon OXYGEN]]、[[L3Harris Tactical Network Demo]]、[[DoD EMS Superiority Strategy]]、[[FutureG ISAC]] / spectrum sharing 等項目，說明 FHSS / frequency-agile operation 與 5G / 6G coexistence 的整合方向。
- 時程展望：來源給出 short term 2025–2028、mid term 2028–2032、long term 2032–2035+ 三段式展望，包含 5G tactical networks scale-out、mmWave phased arrays field testing、5G/6G-capable SD radios、early ISAC for drone detection / perimeter defense、URLLC for autonomy、full 6G with integrated sensing、AI-native battlefield connectivity 與 spectrum-aware autonomy。
- Call to action：重新接觸既有 CMX customers，尤其 DOW customers；與 integrators 溝通；保持 tactical patience；提早 engage BDM organization；跨團隊分享 lessons learned。

Smart Jamming › Mitigation direction
兩份來源的主要 mitigation direction 都是 [[Frequency hopping for 5G resilience]]。白皮書將其具體化為 [[Handover frequency hopping]]：

- 使用 [[5G Handover]] 在 n41、n78、n79 等不同 carrier frequency / cell 間切換；
- 讓 jammer 必須 constantly listen and readjust to every change；
- 若 procedure completed at a high frequency rate，jammer would not be able to keep up；
- dynamic target-cell activation 可隱藏 next hop information。

使用限制：白皮書沒有實體 jammer 對抗實驗細節，主要量測 handover interruption、RTT、iPerf 與 [[WebRTC]] QoS。

Smart Jamming › unresolved
- 來源未定義 smart jammer 的完整技術分類、訊號特徵或 detection criteria。
- 來源未提供 jammer profile、jammer power、距離、頻段、掃頻 / 跳頻策略、dwell time 或 attack timeline。
- 來源未說明 smart-jamming test 是否使用實體 jammer、emulation、channel emulator 或 network-side impairment injection。
- [[5G-hardening-against-smart-jammer-attacks_wp_en_3610-1591-52_v0100]] 的實驗並未提供 jammer reacquisition time 或 jamming success probability，因此不能量化 anti-jam security gain。

Frequency hopping for 5G resilience › 與 5G handover 的映射
[[2025-12-19 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient]] 把方法映射到：

- [[5G Handover]] signaling procedure；
- 5G frequency-hopping / frequency agility behavior；
- UE-reported band support；
- [[HO interruption interval]]，並標註 message definitions / intervals per [[3GPP TS 38.300]]。

[[5G-hardening-against-smart-jammer-attacks_wp_en_3610-1591-52_v0100]] 進一步說明：5G operates on a fixed frequency for each cell；雖然已有 limited form of frequency hopping，但它 confined to the cell bandwidth and resource block allocation。白皮書提出利用 inter-frequency handover 在不同 cells / carriers 間切換，讓 5G 表現得像 frequency hopping。

XLAPI-CMX_Scenario_Database › CMX-KF603X 與 CMX-KF604X：NR SA Signaling / Mobility
[[R&S CMX-KF603X]] 涵蓋 NR SA RRC procedures、5GS NAS procedures、PDU sessions、SMS over NAS、RLF 與 throughput performance：

- 已 verified 項目包含 RRC Connection Reject、CDRX、Paging、RRC Suspension / Resumption、Initial Registration、PDU Session Establishment、Deregistration、SMS over NAS 與 RLF re-establishment。
- NR SA throughput scripts 包含 1 Gbit/s / 2 Gbit/s downlink、2x2 / 4x4 MIMO 與 uplink throughput；來源同時出現 `1 GBps` / `1 Gbps` 字樣，需保留原文差異。

[[R&S CMX-KF604X]] 涵蓋 Cell selection / reselection、5GC mobility、measurement reporting、mobility with EUTRAN、handover recovery、BWP switching 與 LADN。多個 cell reselection 與 handover 項目為 verified，部分 target-cell / PCell-SCell 變換仍為 defined / TBD。
